initialize.instructions: FilmCraft video editor (Premiere Pro-class). Every edit is an engine command: `command_list` to discover ids/params, `command_run` to execute (undoable; `command_batch` runs several). `doc_inspect` (or `project_inspect`/`sequence_inspect`) returns ids you can pass to commands; `render_preview` shows the result. In bridge mode the `ui_*` tools drive the live app: `ui_elements` lists clickable ids, `ui_click`/`ui_drag`/`ui_key` operate it, `ui_screenshot` shows it. Time is in ticks: 254016000000 per second (commands also accept `seconds`, `frame` or `timecode`).

time_representation.inspect_fields: start/end/duration in ticks plus startFrame/endFrame/durationFrames; sourceIn/sourceOut in ticks (media time)
time_representation.command_inputs: ticks, or seconds= / frame= / timecode=; deltaFrames= for trims
